text: 1 hour before sleep, turn off the bright overhead light and leave 1–2 warm sources (a lamp, a floor lamp). This is not about coziness, but about the nervous system: bright light keeps the brain in activity mode, whereas warm light reminds it of the setting sun and the flame of a campfire. After just a week, you may notice that in the evening you relax and feel better, feel yourself and your body better, there are fewer fussy thoughts and desires, you fall asleep faster, and your sleep becomes deeper.
